capability.environment: Claude Code cloud container: Node 22, FFmpeg 6.1, @napi-rs/canvas; ElevenLabs connector for speech and images

limitations.impact: Drawing is consistent line art but not the B1 Ryan V4 hand-inked baseline; review the encoded frames rather than assuming equivalence
limitations.observed: Characters and most props come from generated pose/prop sheets (gemini-3-pro-image) cropped by tools/import-art.mjs; the desk, search box, sticky notes, task card and cursor remain procedural

reviewer.method: Independent frame-exact review of output/film.mp4 (sha256 verified) against output/film-reference/evidence.json's 43-shot plan and review-template.json's schema. For every shot: reviewed the existing start/mid/end PNGs (viewed as batched montages), extracted extra frames directly from film.mp4 with ffmpeg at keyframe/reveal times computed from project.json's per-shot layer keyframes, and ran ffmpeg volumedetect over each shot's exact [start,end) window for the sound check. Cross-checked all B1 claim/question/label rewording shots and the two known non-blocking limitations (shot-17 cut-boundary artifact, shot-22 notebook/chin overlap) against this project's own git history (project.json commit log) to confirm current state against prior review rounds. Compared character, acting, composition, sound and timing against the b1-ryan-v4 approved baseline video via direct frame extraction and ffmpeg volumedetect on that reference file.
